status.en: 22 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 16% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Sulaymaniyah.
status.nb: 22 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 16 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Sulaymaniyah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces have moved into the Iran-backed militia strongholds of Jurf al-Sakhar and Jurf al-Nasr under a newly-brokered joint security command, while Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has also ordered a separate command for the region, expanding state control. Security forces are probing a deadly gas pipeline blast in Basra and have deployed to Jurf al-Sakhar following a deal with the militia, while also establishing new security posts to protect oil assets at Jurf Al-Nasr. Arrest warrants have been issued in Najaf for a provincial council member linked to an oil smuggling operation, and security forces are pursuing two suspects in the case. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker har rykket inn i de Iran-støttede militsens sterkeholdene Jurf al-Sakhar og Jurf al-Nasr under en nyforhandlet felles sikkerhetskommando, mens statsminister Ali al-Zaidi også har beordret en egen kommando for regionen, og utvidet statens kontroll. Sikkerhetsstyrkene etterforsker en dødelig gassrørledningseksplosjon i Basra og har blitt utplassert til Jurf al-Sakhar etter en avtale med militsen, samtidig som de oppretter nye sikkerhetsposter for å beskytte oljearrangementer i Jurf al-Nasr. Arrestordrer er utstedt i Najaf for et provinsielt rådmedlem knyttet til en oljesmuglingsoperasjon, og sikkerhetsstyrkene jakter på to mistenkte i saken. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
